info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Extraction API

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Document Understanding project

params.name: api-version
params.description: API version to use for this request

items.docs: Submits a previously digitized document for asynchronous data extraction. The extractors to apply and the document type must be specified in the request body. Returns a requestId to poll for results. Results are retained for 24 hours. Use GET /extraction/{requestId}/result to retrieve extracted field values once processing completes.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Document Understanding project

params.name: requestId
params.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous job request to retrieve results for

params.name: api-version
params.description: API version to use for this request

items.docs: Retrieves the result of an asynchronous extraction request by its requestId. The job status can be NotStarted, Running, Failed, or Succeeded. Poll this endpoint until the status is Succeeded or Failed. Returns extracted field values with associated confidence scores. Results are available for 24 hours from the time the job completed.
